{{Resonator Tabs}} {{Language Tabs}} ==About Voicelines== {{VO |character = Lingyang |language = en |vo_01_01_title = Thoughts: I |vo_01_01_file = {character}{language} Thoughts I.ogg |vo_01_01_tx = Size isn't everything, you know. I may not look it, but I've got quite a bit of strength that lets me handle any physical work no problem! If you ever need a hand, just let me know! I'm always happy to help out! |vo_01_02_title = Thoughts: II |vo_01_02_intimacy = 1 |vo_01_02_file = {character}{language} Thoughts II.ogg |vo_01_02_tx = Curious about these bandages? They're mostly from my liondance rehearsals, and the rest, well, I got them from my battles in the wild. What about the bandages on your wrist, battle scars too? Wish I could have protected you... I'd rather take the hit myself any day over seeing someone hurt. |vo_01_03_title = Thoughts: III |vo_01_03_intimacy = 2 |vo_01_03_file = {character}{language} Thoughts III.ogg |vo_01_03_tx = Words hold incredible power. In {{Extra Effect|Huanglong|Huanglong|Located at the edge of the continent, this country borders the sea to the east. It boasts a vast territory with one capital and six major cities.}}, we believe spoken words may manifest into reality. Then if even jokes have a chance to come true, why not good wishes and blessings? That's why we should always express our positive thoughts out loud. Who knows, maybe there is a higher power listening and ready to grant our desires. So, I make sure to say my Lucky Greetings to everyone, as often as possible! |vo_01_04_title = Thoughts: IV |vo_01_04_intimacy = 3 |vo_01_04_file = {character}{language} Thoughts IV.ogg |vo_01_04_tx = I wish I could show you my hometown, but it's not the same anymore. It's been turned into a {{Extra Effect|Tacet Field|Tacet Field|The "Tacet Fields" are thought to be where all Tacet Discords originate. These locations feature a sky of inverted seas and a deep cross-shaped Tacet Mark on the ground. Reverberations fill the air, linking our world to an unknown space through a white Resonance Cord. These areas attract gatherings of Tacet Discords.}}, without any life or joy. I prefer living in vibrant places, where there's energy and excitement. But one day, when we overcome the {{Extra Effect|Lament|Lament|The term "Lament" refers to the ongoing catastrophic events on Solaris-3. Since the onset of the first Lament, the cycle of destruction has persisted relentlessly. The tide of devastation remains ceaseless, with no signs of stopping.}} and bring back the beauty of this land, I'll take you there. You'll see the tallest trees, twinkling fireflies, and a river glittering with stars... Yes, we'll see that day... |vo_01_05_title = Thoughts: V |vo_01_05_intimacy = 4 |vo_01_05_file = {character}{language} Thoughts V.ogg |vo_01_05_tx = I'm no longer afraid of letting people see my real appearance, but... I guess I still look rather different, and not everyone is so accepting of that. Sometimes I just want to lend a helping hand, and they'd assume I'm trying to claw at them or something... Erm, what do you think, Rover? Do I look scary to you? |vo_02_01_title = Lingyang's Hobby |vo_02_01_file = {character}{language} Hobby.ogg |vo_02_01_tx = I love people-watching. It's fascinating to see so many different faces and backgrounds come to watch the {{Extra Effect|liondance|Liondance|Liondance is combination of martial arts and choreography that has now become a signature folk art in Jinzhou. It originated from traditional boxing and martial arts in Huanglong, emphasizing swift footwork and powerful postures.}}. Each person brings their own story and personality... I guess they're just, just like... leaves? I've never come across two identical leaves. Every one of them is unique. And you, Rover, I want to know more about you so bad... Tell me more, please? |vo_02_02_title = Lingyang's Trouble |vo_02_02_file = {character}{language} Trouble.ogg |vo_02_02_tx = "Feel the drum and dance along," they say. In {{Extra Effect|liondance}}, there isn't really a set melody we dance to. It's all about finding the perfect balance between movement and music. Everyone in our troupe must attend both Mr. Wufang's liondance classes and Mr. Qixing's drumming classes. And let me tell you, I struggle with the drums. Catching the beat is always tricky. I do better in the liondance class, but I often get lost in the dance and forget to keep up with the beat... Luckily, I can still manage to pull off the performance smoothly, thanks to my fellow troupe members. They often tweak the drumbeat tempo to match my rhythm. As my Master likes to point out, I'm a classic case of being "good at some things but not so much at others." |vo_02_03_title = Favorite Food |vo_02_03_file = {character}{language} Favorite Food.ogg |vo_02_03_tx = Medium-rare is the way to go for grilled meat. That tender texture with a hint of secret spices... mmm, delicious! Trust me, I know all about it. Have you tried those "Medium Rare" skewers in Jinzhou? I'm the genius behind them, and now they're all the rage! |vo_02_04_title = Disliked Food |vo_02_04_file = {character}{language} Disliked Food.ogg |vo_02_04_tx = Hmm... you've got a point there. Would grilled veggies taste any better? |vo_02_05_title = Ideals |vo_02_05_file = {character}{language} Ideals.ogg |vo_02_05_tx = The liondance tradition is all about banishing evil, guarding fortune, and beckoning blessings. I want to be the best dancer out there to keep this tradition thriving. My Master always reminds me not to aim too high and bite off more than I can chew. I know there's still a long road ahead in perfecting my skills, but as long as I keep moving steadily from one pole to another, like we do in the tournaments, I'll surely reach my goal, no matter how high or far away it may seem. |vo_03_01_title = Chat: I |vo_03_01_file = {character}{language} Chat I.ogg |vo_03_01_tx = Why do I keep this liondance head with me? Well, when I first got to Jinzhou, I was afraid to take it off. I didn't want people to see that I looked different from everyone else. Wearing the head made me feel safe, like I could hide my appearance and just focus on dancing. Maybe back then, I thought that only by wearing the liondance head could I truly be myself without judgement. |vo_03_02_title = Chat: II |vo_03_02_file = {character}{language} Chat II.ogg |vo_03_02_tx = For some reason, people seem obsessed with my tail. Sometimes my seniors like to play their little drums to the beat of my swishing tail. But honestly, I have no idea how to control it. It's more like some kind of... reflex? When I feel happy—like right now, it just starts wagging on its own. |vo_04_01_title = About [[Jiyan]] |vo_04_01_intimacy = 1 |vo_04_01_file = {character}{language} About Jiyan.ogg |vo_04_01_tx = In {{Extra Effect|Jinzhou|Jinzhou|Jinzhou, a fortified city on the frontier, stands guard against the looming Tacet Discord crisis. As one of Huanglong's six major regions, it bears the weight of this responsibility as the youngest provincial capital. The Midnight Rangers defend its northern border without hesitation.}}, the {{Extra Effect|liondance}} tradition started as a way to celebrate victories in battle. And nowadays, we always perform before our soldiers go into battle—it's like a good luck charm and morale booster. Our {{Extra Effect|Liondance Troupe|Liondance Troupe|A traveling performance group specializing in the traditional Liondance. They take commissions from both the Jinzhou Theater and private clients to support themselves and cover their travel expenses.}} has been traveling between military camps in various regions to deliver performances. I'll never forget my first time leading a pre-battle show. I was nervous and messed up here and there, but General Jiyan didn't get mad at me. He actually encouraged me a lot. He isn't as strict as he seems in public, is he? No wonder the soldiers admire him so much... He's really a strong and kind person. |vo_04_01_mention = Jiyan |vo_04_02_title = About [[Jianxin]] |vo_04_02_intimacy = 1 |vo_04_02_file = {character}{language} About Jianxin.ogg |vo_04_02_tx = {{Extra Effect|Liondance|Liondance|Liondance is combination of martial arts and choreography that has now become a signature folk art in Jinzhou. It originated from traditional boxing and martial arts in Huanglong, emphasizing swift footwork and powerful postures.}} is a fusion of martial arts and dance. It originated from traditional boxing and martial arts in {{Extra Effect|Huanglong}}, emphasizing swift footwork and powerful postures. Miss Jianxin practices Fengyiquan, a contrasting style to liondance, but just as impressive. I once saw her effortlessly take down seven men with a single punch! The Fengyiquan truly lives up to its reputation: conquering the unyielding with the yielding. |vo_04_02_mention = Jianxin |vo_04_03_title = About [[Taoqi]] |vo_04_03_intimacy = 2 |vo_04_03_file = {character}{language} About Taoqi.ogg |vo_04_03_tx = The Qixing Drum's sound echoes far and wide, and people say it scares evil spirits and beasts away. I never thought anyone could sleep through that loud banging, but then I met this pink-haired lady called Taoqi... Turns out she's the Chief Officer of border defense at the {{Extra Effect|Ministry of Development|Ministry of Development|The Ministry of Development serves as the engineering and construction arm of the Central Office of State Affairs.
It is comprised of three key divisions: the Ordnance and Defense Divisions, which handle all military applications. And the Infrastructure Division, tasked with public works and construction projects.}}. With all the defenses in Jinzhou, I'd be tired too... Maybe she is just too exhausted from work? I hope she can catch some good rest. |vo_04_03_mention = Taoqi |vo_04_04_title = About [[Yuanwu]] |vo_04_04_intimacy = 2 |vo_04_04_file = {character}{language} About Yuanwu.ogg |vo_04_04_tx = Uncle Yuanwu keeps lots of street cats at his boxing gym. I often bring them fish I've caught as thank-yous for, let's say, helping me practice. I wonder if those cats are picking up on his moves? Maybe I can draw some inspiration from that. By the way, Uncle Yuanwu's dried fish is super delicious! |vo_04_04_mention = Yuanwu |vo_04_05_title = About [[Mortefi]] |vo_04_05_intimacy = 3 |vo_04_05_file = {character}{language} About Mortefi.ogg |vo_04_05_tx = Don't let Mr. Mortefi's permanent 'Do-Not-Disturb' face fool you, he's actually a big kid at heart. He's the genius behind all those fun toys for Jinzhou's children, and he even created some sick merch for our {{Extra Effect|Liondance Troupe}}! So when you need his help, don't hesitate to tell him—just do it politely and he'll surely lend you a hand! |vo_04_05_mention = Mortefi |vo_04_06_title = About [[Chixia]] |vo_04_06_intimacy = 3 |vo_04_06_file = {character}{language} About Chixia.ogg |vo_04_06_tx = Chixia? Aha, you mean my top rival! I won't let her outshine me again... And why is that, you ask? Well, we're battling to see who can help more people! |vo_04_06_mention = Chixia |vo_04_07_title = About [[Yangyang]] |vo_04_07_intimacy = 4 |vo_04_07_file = {character}{language} About Yangyang.ogg |vo_04_07_tx = I love Yangyang's singing! I've been trying to convince her to sing at our theater, but she keeps turning me down.... Says she's embarrassed to sing in front of a crowd. I don't get it! It's just like liondancing—once you take that first step, the rest falls into place! |vo_04_07_mention = Yangyang |vo_04_08_title = About [[Baizhi]] |vo_04_08_intimacy = 4 |vo_04_08_file = {character}{language} About Baizhi.ogg |vo_04_08_tx = The {{Extra Effect|Remnant|Remnant Energy|A form of pure energy with complete frequencies. The information it carries transcends time and space, enduring in a stable, unchanging state.}} Creature that hangs around Baizhi... It's called {{Extra Effect|You'tan|You'tan|A Remnant Creature reminiscent of a white udumbara. It can communicate with Baizhi through telepathy.}}, right? I once thought it was my kind. Aw. I wish it really was… |vo_04_08_mention = Baizhi |vo_05_01_title = Birthday Wishes |vo_05_01_file = {character}{language} Birthday Wishes.ogg |vo_05_01_tx = Happy birthday! May your life be filled with joy and delight, as you chase your dreams and reach new heights. May happiness follow wherever you go, may your journey be a wonderful show! Hehe, I've come up with a special liondance just for you! Can you spend some more time here with me today? Because, well, this dance might run a little long. |vo_06_01_title = Idle: I |vo_06_01_file = {character}{language} Idle I.ogg |vo_06_01_tx = Awoo—Lion up! Victory is mine at this year's Greens-plucking Tournament! |vo_06_02_title = Idle: II |vo_06_02_file = {character}{language} Idle II.ogg |vo_06_02_tx = Warm-up's done. Ready for stage! |vo_06_03_title = Idle: III |vo_06_03_file = {character}{language} Idle III.ogg |vo_06_03_tx = Hmm? Did I just hear something? It feels off to not hear the drums... |vo_07_01_title = Self-Introduction |vo_07_01_file = {character}{language} Self-Introduction.ogg |vo_07_01_tx = Hiya, I'm Lingyang. You're probably more used to seeing me as that liondancer on the high poles, I guess? Let's hang out more! I want you to remember what I look like, without the liondance head! |vo_07_02_title = Greeting |vo_07_02_file = {character}{language} Greeting.ogg |vo_07_02_tx = Opening greeting—Foul spirits begone, all safe and sound! |vo_08_01_title = Join Team: I |vo_08_01_file = {character}{language} Join Team I.ogg |vo_08_01_tx = Hmm? Where are you going? Count me in! |vo_08_02_title = Join Team: II |vo_08_02_file = {character}{language} Join Team II.ogg |vo_08_02_tx = Shh... I sneaked myself out. Promise you won't tell, okay? |vo_08_03_title = Join Team: III |vo_08_03_file = {character}{language} Join Team III.ogg |vo_08_03_tx = Here's to a safe journey ahead. |vo_09_01_title = Ascension: I |vo_09_01_ascension = 1 |vo_09_01_file = {character}{language} Ascension I.ogg |vo_09_01_tx = Great! That's a new move for me! |vo_09_02_title = Ascension: II |vo_09_02_ascension = 2 |vo_09_02_file = {character}{language} Ascension II.ogg |vo_09_02_tx = No more slacking off now that you're here to help! I should practice harder. |vo_09_03_title = Ascension: III |vo_09_03_ascension = 3 |vo_09_03_file = {character}{language} Ascension III.ogg |vo_09_03_tx = So this is what they mean by "Beyond the mountain lies a broader world"... Thank you, Rover! I couldn't have made it this far without you. Now I'm ready to challenge higher Plum Blossom Poles. |vo_09_04_title = Ascension: IV |vo_09_04_ascension = 4 |vo_09_04_file = {character}{language} Ascension IV.ogg |vo_09_04_tx = My Master once told me this: Never lose reverence for the "highest pole", no matter how much you've achieved. There's always someone better, and always more to learn, so we should always stay humble. I'll keep cultivating myself with this reverence in mind. Besides, there's someone right in front of me that I want to catch up to. |vo_09_05_title = Ascension: V |vo_09_05_ascension = 5 |vo_09_05_file = {character}{language} Ascension V.ogg |vo_09_05_tx = Legend has it that the {{Extra Effect|liondance}} was created by ancient sages, inspired by the movement of constellations in the sky. True mastery of it allows one to draw power from the world, to form a miniature cosmos within. ...Now I think I've finally caught a glimpse into that realm. I've still got a long way ahead, but at least I can better protect you now. }} ==Combat== {{Combat VO |character = Lingyang |language = en |normal_1_tx = This might hurt. |normal_2_tx = Take this! |normal_3_tx = Hah! |normal_4_tx = Time for the high-pole moves! |normal_5_tx = Celestial blessings! |normal_6_tx = Beat the drum.
